comparator.sourceNotes: Appendix 2.3–2.5 of the 2026–2027 regulations establishes the ordinary 180 EC pathway, including the Bachelor Project as one 15 EC component, 30 EC genuine choice and the compulsory methods progression. No named route applies.

components.name: Electives / Minor / Exchange / Internship
components.note: 30 EC of approved electives, minor, exchange or supervised internship. No more than 10 EC of electives may be introductory first-year courses.

components.name: Bachelor Project
components.note: One 15 EC thesis spanning blocks 2a and 2b. Requires GIS, Statistics 2 and both qualitative and quantitative research methods.
